source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιοι Φιλήμων, Άρχιππος και Ονήσιμος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives no year. The corpus already keeps his two companions of this line as `philemon-6-july` and `archippus-6-july`, kept apart there from `philemon-the-apostle` and `archippus-the-apostle`, so his own folder is kept apart in the same way from `onesimus-the-apostle`, whose Greek row is 15 February: two entries on one calendar are two commemorations. The corpus's `onesimus-10-may` and `onesimus-of-soissons` are other men on other days. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
